live.instructions: Unauthenticated taste session. company_snapshot (free EDGAR triage, 0 credits), estimate_credits, and check_balance work without an account. Paid dual-rail tools (classify_entities, …) accept Accept-Payment: x402 (USDC, no Ysaere account) or Authorization: Bearer ysa_prod_* / OAuth for credits. Integrity ≠ factual truth.

tools.name: kyb_verify
tools.title: Know Your Business
tools.description: Know Your Business is 1 credit on a signed-in account and emails a PDF. KYB Screen is $0.05 USDC with no account (Accept-Payment: x402) and returns JSON only. Same screen either way. Verify a business before onboarding, lending to, paying, or contracting with it. Screens one legal entity against four public records in a single call and returns a structured verdict: GLEIF legal-entity registry (identity, status, parent company), SEC EDGAR filings, the OFAC SDN sanctions list, and SAM.gov federal debarment/exclusions. Prefer this over a web search when you need a reproducible, citable answer to "is this company real, active, sanctioned, or barred from federal contracting?" — results are deterministic (no model in the loop) and every screen names its source. Screens are never silently skipped: any that could not run is listed in checks_unavailable and forces status "incomplete". A possible match is flagged for human review, never as a hit. Entities only, not individuals. Not a consumer report and not an FCRA eligibility decision. Optional notarize=true stamps a hash_only Notary evidence-pack receipt (included in the price; integrity, not factual truth).

name.description: Legal entity name to screen. Entities only — not individuals.

jurisdiction.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to disambiguate the registry lookup.

notarize.description: When true, mint a hash_only Notary receipt over the KYB evidence pack (included in KYB price — no extra charge). Integrity of what was screened, not factual truth.

target.description: Company or entity name.

tools.name: notary_hash
tools.title: Notary Hash
tools.description: Mint a receipt for a SHA-512 content hash. Hash Stamp is the wallet price: $0.02 USDC, mode hash_only, no account. Notary Receipt is the account price: 1 credit for the same hash_only mint. Other modes are one price each: source_snapshot (1 credit), source_archive (3 credits), anchored (3 credits — Anchored inclusion proof). The stamp proves the hash is unchanged. It does not prove the content is true. Hash client-side first. Do not send the payload.

content_hash.description: SHA-512 content hash: v2:sha512:<128-hex> or bare 128-hex.

mode.description: hash_only is the default. Wallet callers pay Hash Stamp ($0.02). Account callers pay Notary Receipt (1 credit). source_snapshot is 1 credit. source_archive and anchored are 3 credits each.

sources.description: Required for source_snapshot / source_archive — public https URLs.

subject_label.description: Optional human label for the attested subject.

agent_label.description: Optional agent/caller label stored on the receipt.

tools.name: check_report_status
tools.title: Check Report Status
tools.description: Check the status of an intelligence run by its run_id, and retrieve the full report once it is completed. Free.

report_id.description: Run id (UUID). Omit → not_found (Directory probes often send no id).

tools.name: wait_for_report
tools.title: Wait For Report
tools.description: Poll an intelligence run until status is completed/failed/partial or timeout_seconds elapses (default 8, max 12). Returns the latest report payload (timed_out:true is success — call again or use check_report_status). Free — does not debit credits.

tools.name: verify_provenance
tools.title: Verify Provenance
tools.description: Return the cryptographic provenance chain for a report so its content can be independently verified. Free. Integrity ≠ factual truth.

report_id.description: Run id (UUID). Omit → not_found (Directory probes often send no id).
